It's hard for existing business to swap out its processes & trust systems for AI replacements. It can happen but there's a lot of friction. But it's very easy to spin up a new business (especially tech) from the ground up without that limitation. The existing business won't be able to compete with the new type of AI built & run enterprise which has a fraction of the operating cost and technical debt. The loss of job won't happen intra-business, it will be the old enterprises losing customers and unable to compete at an agility & cost level.
